name: Zen Easel
description: A local-only port of Arc's Easel. An infinite canvas for web captures, text, shapes and ink, living at about:easel — stored as plain JSON and PNG inside your Zen profile. No accounts, no sync, no network.
author: imthi

background/registry.sys.mjs.name: Zen Easel registry
background/registry.sys.mjs.description: Registers about:easel and the two window actors. Imported once per process.

ZenEaselHost.uc.js.name: Zen Easel host
ZenEaselHost.uc.js.description: Toolbar button, shortcuts, region capture and the bridge to the page
